verdict.rationale: PayPal documents online acceptance of debit and credit cards alongside PayPal, Venmo and Pay Later (paypal-docs-29, paypal-docs-12). A no-code Payment Link (paypal-docs-31) and the PayPal button checkout (paypal-docs-37) give a quick path to taking a first card payment, and Expanded Checkout adds branded card fields (paypal-docs-27). One user report says new sellers' funds may sit in a pending balance for up to 21 days (paypal-comm-8), which delays access to money but not acceptance itself. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of signup-to-first-live-payment time or account verification/onboarding duration, and independent hands-on corroboration of same-day go-live.
